audience: social media managers who publish posts and check results on accounts linked to Ayrshare

useCases.title: Check the results of recent posts
useCases.text: List the post history of the last days, then read one post with its status per network. Read its likes, impressions and views.

useCases.title: Check the monthly post count and quota
useCases.text: Read the profile this connection uses, with its linked accounts and its monthly post count and quota. List the User Profiles of the account.

useCases.title: Review follower and engagement analytics
useCases.text: Read follower and engagement analytics for the linked social accounts on the networks you choose.

useCases.title: Read the comments on a post
useCases.text: List the comments on one post by its Ayrshare Post ID, or by the network's own post ID.

useCases.title: Publish or schedule a post
useCases.text: Publish a post now to the chosen accounts, or schedule it with a UTC date. Pass an idempotency key so a repeated call is rejected instead of posting twice.

useCases.title: Remove a post or a comment
useCases.text: Delete a post from its social networks, or delete one comment. Deleted posts cannot be restored.
